# A voucher code whose voucher was never published is read for until another code takes its
# place, or the group is left; then it is read for no more.

create alice g
run
invite-code alice g AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=
run 60
state alice g
----
joined, adding a member

pending alice
----
ReadVoucher

join bob g
run
invite alice g bob
run
members alice g
----
bob

pending alice
----
Wake

create alice h
run
invite-code alice h AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=
run 60
pending alice
----
ReadVoucher Wake

leave alice h
run 60
pending alice
----
Wake
